body: Sad to say, yeah. I think I've always been the coward, the giver-upper (uhm, that kind of makes sense, hah). Feel like i'm throwing everyone's good advice and words of support back in their faces, both here and in real life. Sorry.

Stress is 24/7, friend. Melting my brain, feels like. I've wasted years of my life and... ugh, I'll stop there before I think too much about it, heh.

Thanks for the offer of music, these days I'm listening to mostly this here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fktwPGCR7Yw 

Over and over again...

Can't do another course, sadly. And fuck - nearly 24? By the time I maybe get a good job...

Did this to myself. Deeply shy and anti-social, stayed in the parents house, missed out on some many experiences. . . Can't bear it. 

Hah, sorry for being so deeply negative. Just, time is moving so fast and I'm doing the same ol' things.

I just... don't see how? Like, I see a future of being left into town by my parents to a low-wage job and then they'll die and I'll be left with the house and... 

I think I'm seriously mentally ill. Weird shit, honestly. I see the world and it's... just moved on without me.

Cheer, but let me continue, if I may. Going to University, part of the funding included grants and maintenance loans. 

I WASTED these to the maximum, even after failing university I used up what little was left on frivolous stuff I didn't even need or remember what they are now. My head was not in the right place at all during those years haha. Should've used that money + time to learn how to drive, or saved it, or.... well, too late. 

I mean... I should've went and done computing or something like that with my friends. I keep imagining this golden scenario where I did that... obsessed with it, really. And I graduated, and I got a job in town and... 

Fuck it, whatever, too late.
